scope: Descriptive prior-context differences over original full Set-Go support; no causal, prospective prediction, GPFA reproduction or population-generalization claim.

retained_scope.strata: split x recording segment x effector x direction; both prior levels and source support/counts explicit

outputs: four signed quarter means of the long-prior minus short-prior rate difference
four quarter root-mean-square differences over all54units and five fixed phase bins
selected_summary.reference_rate: For each trial/bin, counts divided by its actual seconds of exposure; prior-specific equal-trial means within the declared cell. Keep this distinct from exposure-weighted pooled rates.
selected_summary.categorical_mapping: Bind long/short labels to authenticated original metadata; do not infer numeric label meanings.
selected_summary.missing: No contrast where required prior support/exposure is absent; return explicit unsupported status/counts, never zero-fill.

superseded_before_data: Earlier five-value proposal lost signed temporal reversal information. Preserve its proposal and independent counterexample. Four signed quarters plus four RMS now selected; whole signed mean is redundant.
matched_information_condition: Both typed viewer and programme receive the same complete54x20 prior-specific mean trajectories and support on common axes. Do not deliver evaluator differences. Extra trial-level programme observations are a separately labelled information condition.
evaluation: Continuous error on declared summaries plus support/uncertainty qualification. No widened viewer tolerance, arbitrary binary win or required positive contrast. Report precision limitations empirically.
uncertainty: Inferential uncertainty remains not qualified by six recording segments; no invented bootstrap/randomization or independent-animal claim. Preserve within-session descriptive scope.
limitations: Eight summaries cannot establish complete unit-level temporal geometry.
This is a prospective benchmark summary, not an original paper metric.
No authentic neural arrays have been read for this selection.
authority: Task-local implementation, meaningful generated checks and independent review within existing grants. No authentic/native/model execution or readiness promotion.
